infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Elizade Connect uses the camera so you can photograph your vehicle for a trade-in valuation, a warranty claim, or a support ticket.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Elizade Connect needs access to your photos so you can attach images to warranty claims, support tickets, and vehicle ownership documents.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Elizade Connect uses Face ID to unlock the app so your vehicle, service and warranty details stay private if your phone is left unattended.
